title: Installation of the Fwd Cargo Door Surround Corner Fittings

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Fuselage Section 13 — Forward — Door Surround Structure

abstract: Installation of the four corner fittings at the forward cargo door cut-out, with the wet assembly, the torque sequence and the operational test that close the task out.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install the four corner fittings of the forward cargo door cut-out after removal or replacement, and to return the cargo compartment to the serviceable condition.
sections.job_setup_note: The frame web must be clean, dry and free of any recorded finding before you start. Have the sealant mixed and within its pot life at the moment you offer the first fitting up, because the joint must be closed wet. Two people are needed throughout. The torque sequence is not the same as the removal sequence and must be followed exactly as given, because the fitting can be pulled out of plane if the outboard fasteners are torqued first.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the frame web assembly D5321003375416 is clean and that no open finding is recorded against it. 2. Remove the protective covers from the fastener holes. 3. Apply the sealant to the faying surface of the first fitting. CAUTION: DO NOT LET THE SEALANT GO INTO THE FASTENER HOLES. THE FASTENER CANNOT THEN BE TORQUED CORRECTLY. 4. Put the fitting in position and install the bolts AES495354-07 and the washers AES963502K7 finger tight. 5. Torque the fasteners in the sequence given in the illustration, starting at the inboard row. 6. Do steps 3 to 5 again for the other three fittings. 7. Apply the sealant fillet at the edge of each fitting. 8. Let the sealant cure for the time given in the standard practice. 9. Restore the protective treatment to all the disturbed surfaces. 10. Install the lower shell lining panels in zones 113 and 115. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT NO TOOL OR FASTENER STAYS IN THE COMPARTMENT BEFORE YOU CLOSE THE LINING. A LOOSE OBJECT CAN JAM THE CARGO LOADING SYSTEM. 11. Install the cargo floor panels. 12. Energise the cargo loading system and do the cargo door operational test.
sections.close_out: Remove the warning notices and the maintenance stay. Do a general visual inspection of the compartment and confirm that all the panels are correctly attached. Record the fastener torque values and the sealant batch on the aircraft work card. Make an entry in the aircraft technical log that the cargo door operational test is satisfactory.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Post MOD-160142 aircraft use the titanium fitting torque table; pre-modification aircraft use the aluminium-lithium table in the same illustration.

safety_precautions: Put the warning notices in position at the cargo loading panel.
Make sure that the forward cargo door maintenance stay is installed.
Obey the sealant handling precautions in the standard practice.
